description: List a shop's named agent keys (owner only): label, scopes, audience, when made, last used (last_used_at, to the minute; null and never_used true if the key was never used) and revoked. Keys don't expire; revoke a key the shop no longer uses. The key itself is never returned. Filter by audience (any or mcp) or include revoked keys.
name: keys_list

last_used_at.description: When the key last signed a request, to the minute. Null if never used.

used_at.description: Same as last_used_at (kept for older agents).
